Episode 184. Beyond Fate (3)
Jin Runcandel descends.
All of our allies on the battlefield were looking at the red, glowing text. Even the Chaos Dragon and the Black Hawk seemed to pause for a moment.
In this battlefield, the name 'Jin Runcandel' carried such a heavy weight. To both our allies and enemies.
The army of chaos is a monstrous creation of blood, and to them, Rosa is like a 'mother'.
But the focus and affection of that mother is solely for one person named Jin Runcandel.
These monstrous creations were aware that they could not even be compared to Jin.
They could read Rosa's innermost thoughts.
They knew where her will and heart were directed, what single thing she wanted, and what lay at the end of that unconditional love and hatred.
The monstrous creations harbored a twisted sense of inferiority towards Jin.
As Rosa became more complete, the creations began to read her innermost thoughts more clearly, and now was the moment when their immense resentment towards Jin was exploding.
[Jin... Run... Candle!]
One Chaos Dragon roared in a husky voice filled with evil, charging at Jin. The mobs following the beast were also attacking Jin, who was descending.
"So it speaks human language."
Jin said dryly. For a moment, Jin's figure disappeared behind the Chaos Dragons.
Slash-!
Bradamante drew a semicircle. The Chaos Dragons that had attacked Jin were pierced or cut into pieces, scattering in the air even before the afterimage of the semicircle disappeared.
In the blink of an eye, about twenty Chaos Dragons had been killed.
Jin was unaffected by the influence of the battlefield.
It was not because Jin was a creature born of Rosa like the monstrous creations.
A mantle-like energy barrier was counteracting the force of the battlefield.
"How inappropriate."
Jin, still descending, scattered frost magic in the air to form a path.
Under Jin's feet rushing towards the battlefield, ice crystals shining like the Milky Way were scattered.
Spirit Sword First Form, Soul Cutting.
A man swung his sword towards the enormous battlefield. No matter how sharp his sword, considering the size of the battlefield, it would only create a small crack at most.
But the sword of Jin, falling vertically, showed no sign of stopping. In line with the speed at which gravity was pulling him, the battlefield was splitting in half.
"Protect Jin!"
"Protect the twelve Knights!"
Protection was not needed. The breath of the Chaos Dragon and the main cannons of the Black Hawks swarmed over Jin like bees, but they couldn't penetrate the wide-spreading energy barrier.
Jin was wholly focused on slicing the battlefield, not caring about the others.
By the time Jin landed on the ground, everyone who had witnessed him and the battlefield could only think of one word.
Yin and Yang.
The sight of a giant sword streak cutting straight through the center of the battlefield left even the superhumans speechless for a moment.
It was the battlefield that had just thrown into confusion countless fleets and dragons, the best elites of each force, and heroes of all kinds.
It was torn in half by a single sword.
Of course, the battlefield had not yet disappeared. The tearing had weakened the once merciless gravitational pull, but the gap was too narrow for the fleet and the dragons to enter.
So, there was a job for their allies and confederates.
"Hedo Kyung, Bale!"
At Jin's call, which echoed throughout the battlefield, the two instantly landed and took their places beside him.
"Please open the rift. In the meantime, I'll take responsibility for the airspace."
If it had been anyone else, they might not have understood Jin's words.
He was asking them to open the rift in the battlefield like a door.
But Hedo and Bale immediately took their positions on either side of the rift and grabbed it with both hands.
It was a task that could not be undertaken without the enormous strength that they possessed.
[Roaaaar!]
Crackling... Grinding...
As Hedo and Bale began to pull the rift with all their might, the gap in the battlefield began to widen bit by bit.
Jin changed his sword. As the lightning sword Sigmund was drawn from its sheath, a bluish light gathered at its tip.
At the same time, hundreds of lightning bolts poured down onto the battlefield.
These bolts were not hitting the army of chaos, but were striking our allied fleets and dragons.
This was a sword created not for annihilation, but for protection.
The Guardians' King Sword Satuwang Technique.
However, even for Jin, it was impossible to properly protect so many troops. It couldn't be helped because the lightning had been spread too widely.
'If I could fully unfold the fusion of gods, that would be possible too... but this is enough for now.'
The lightning protection of the Guardians was only a device to make friendly identification easier. The real protection was still Orgal's role.
Rooooar...!
Another god, shaped like a burning bird, exposed its blue and sacred body and roared.
Tess, Jin's newly summoned Phoenix, was watching the enemies with wide-open eyes. The Chaos Dragons rushed to bite his body, but Tess did not allow their snouts to touch him.
The Chaos Dragons burnt out weakly like moths to a flame.
Only the stronger creatures could even ignite near Tess.
The weaker ones couldn't even attempt to attack Tess. They couldn't even approach him before their wing membranes melted and they fell.
There was room to breathe for our allies. The energy used by the fleet to escape the battlefield was refocused on the main cannon, and the superhumans returned to an offensive stance.
The seal of fire in the sky had only been raised a few minutes ago.
In that time, Jin had completely reversed the course of the battle.
The power of one person was pushing away the anxiety that was budding in the hearts of his allies.
The number of Chaos Dragons and dark lines that had been endlessly pouring in had noticeably decreased.
The fleet was now using the gravitational pull of the battlefield like a wind to move forward little by little.
"Roaaar!"
[Gruuuunt!]
The achievements of Hedo and Bale's strength were accelerating.
The straight-line shaped rift that Jin initially made now looked like an oval.
The battlefield was no longer flat. It was grotesquely twisted here and there around the oval-shaped rift, and each of those parts was filled with energy.
"You've worked hard. Lord Hedo, please step aside now."
Jin said, switching his sword again.
And as he swung the Bradamante diagonally twice towards the center of the rift, the energy accumulated in the battlefield exploded like a bursting thread.
Crash-!
One side of the battlefield crumbled like glass.
Our allies inside the ship let out cheers without even realizing it.
It might be a 'temporary' alliance.
But today, everyone is sincerely relying on Jin, believing in Jin.
[We do all the hard work, and you take the glory!]
"If that's unfair, then you make a contract with Solderet, Bale. And give that sword back to me."
[Try to touch my Shakan, you'll see.]
While there were still 3 sides left, Veradin had already been gathering the fleets on his side to the center since the moment Jin landed.
"Advance!"
The fleet began to march beyond the battlefield. No more Chaos Dragons and dark lines appeared from the bottom of the ship, Ram.
The closer to the castle of the evil god, the more dreadful pressure it revealed. Due to the lower altitude, even our allies on the fleet couldn't properly see the sky behind the castle.
The war had just passed its starting point.

The role of the Chaos Dragons and dark lines in the army of the evil god was not very significant. They were sufficient to massacre a large number of people with a ranking of 7 stars or less, but there was a clear limit when facing armies with individuals like Jin or superhumans.
If it hadn't been for the evil god's tremendous battlefield in the first place, the battle wouldn't have been properly established.
The real deal are the swordsmen tainted in chaos.
The old heroes commanding them, the countless variables existing within the castle, and the evil god himself.
The unstable element called Ram continued to exist.
It appeared as if Lyn had stopped Ram as promised, but it could start running at any moment.
'Rosha can't be oblivious to Lyn's betrayal. We must infiltrate the castle with as much power as possible before Ram is normalized. Lyn's sacrifice cannot be in vain.'
Just as Jin was thinking this.
The battlefield began to vibrate. It was as if a gigantic monster was awakening from deep underground, shaking the ground with such a tremor.
The gates of the evil god's castle began to open.
The door, as vast as the deep sea, was filled with profound darkness.
"All fleets, charge the main cannon to full power and fire immediately."
Veradin immediately ordered the firing. He aimed to prevent the alliance from being overwhelmed by the darkness visible through the opened gate.
Jin thought that Veradin had made a very appropriate decision.
The darkness of the castle gate had the power to make people fear just by itself.
Also, there was no reason to wait for the enemy to appear.
Kwaaaaa……!
Hundreds of shots were fired towards the void darkness. The firepower was so immense that, if it were a human castle, the entire castle would disappear without a trace, let alone the gate.
However, the gunfire was no different from a pebble falling into a well.
Although the firing continued, not even a distant explosion was heard from the castle. It was just being sucked in futilely.
"Halt!"
There was no reason to waste energy on useless attacks.
Veradin promptly stopped the firing, but it was undeniable that it had a counterproductive effect.
The full-scale firing of all fleets was no different from a pebble falling into a well.
As with any other war, morale plays a very important role in this battle.
The very presence on the battlefield of the evil god's power was pressuring everyone's inner self, making it even more so.
Veradin had no choice but to consider his command, and a few seconds of silence passed.
Then Jin took a breath and shouted while firing his sword energy.
He randomly fired his sword energy not at the open castle gate but at the castle wall.
Fortunately, unlike the gunfire that simply disappeared into the open castle gate, the castle wall showed signs of being hit by a physical impact.
Sounds of the wall cracking, stone bursting, and a metallic crash were spreading.

"There is no castle in the world that cannot be broken. Today, that castle will disappear without a trace. So, allies should calmly hit the wall and prepare for battle. Enemies will soon come out from the castle."
Jin said this while gripping his sword. He felt a gloomy energy from inside the castle gate writhing as if it was about to explode at any moment.
"And they too, will all die at our hands today."
